summary: A realtime 3v2 on Gasbag Grabens: three Opus 5.5 medium seats (t2 Armada G5, t3 Cortex G3, t4 Armada G2) under an Opus 5.5 high commander against thebluegecko and u6bkep. The commander's plan at 0:02 was a tier-2 sprint at t4 fed by the other two. t4 placed its advanced bot lab at F3 at 3:40, as all eleven of our first raiders were dying at D5-D6 to his larger group, and the feeders' labs paused while the frame took 2:21 (it stood at 6:01) because the feeds moved nothing. Meanwhile his Grunts took all six of t4's extractors (6:13-7:14), u6bkep's commander built a forward bot lab and Beamer at F7 in our half (5:49) that we never struck, and the side never held more than 16 of its 24 spots. From 8:00 u6bkep's Mace and Pawn block razed t2's home and then t3's (t3's commander died at 9:56 and its blast took the base) while t3's body of about 20 walked between G3 and F3, and 21 Grunts killed the advanced lab at 9:17 before its first moho stood. thebluegecko's tier 2 (an Arbiter at 12:38) and a forward nest at F2-F3 (Arbiters, a Sheldon, a Scorpion, a Persecutor) out-ranged t4's last base, and the commander surrendered at about 16:28.

root.what: The side went for the tier-2 sprint at t4 with no cover. The advanced bot lab was placed at F3, 800 west of t4's start and toward the Grunts' E3 path, the minute the first raid had failed in the middle. The commander paused t2's and t3's labs and had t4 eat its tier-1 lab. For the 2:21 the frame took, no seat grew an army or guarded t4's spots, and his forward base at F7 went unanswered. The plant made four advanced constructors and a Welder, then died at 9:17, before its first moho stood (10:22). Our commander's end note and our player's resign line say the same; these are model words, and no person commented.

bears_on.note: u6bkep's block met t2 (8:00-9:33) and t3 (9:33-10:09) one seat at a time, while t3's body of about 20 walked G3-F3 and never reached F5. Our commander's own lesson (2) at 16:28 says the same.
'Hold half the map': the side never held more than 16 of the 24 spots in our half (4:00-6:00), and his forward lab took t2's south at 5:44. The count fell to 11 at 8:00 and 8 at 10:00.
The economy was lost before the army: 16 extractors falling to 8 by 10:00 and his tier 2 at 12:38. His count is unknown (no truth file).
u6bkep's commander stood in our half at F7 from 5:44, 1,900 from t2's home. The strike was planned at 6:11 and never given.
The people eat the tier-1 lab once tier 2 is active. Our procedure ate it at placement (3:41, reclaimed 6:37), and the sprint seat stood without soldiers while Grunts took its spots.
Bounds 'either bomb or t2 now': going tier 2 at 3:40 under two people's raids, with the side's cover paused, lost the plant at 9:17 before its first moho stood.
Our first handful crossed on time (3:21-3:31) but in three seat groups, and died at D5-D6 to his larger group under a Sentry. Against two people the handful met more than a handful.

Both people built forward: u6bkep's lab and Beamer at F7 (5:49), and thebluegecko's Arbiter, Scorpion and Persecutor nest at F2-F3 (13:35-16:02). t4 rightly called off the attack on F3 at 14:42, but had nothing with reach.

bears_on.id: The tier-2 sprint: trigger, conduct, feeding, the team procedure, tier 1 against tier 2 and 3
bears_on.note: This is the first test against people of the 2026-10-18/19 team procedure, which tells the feeders their plants make nothing. That removed the cover the backlog says a team game provides. The feed moved 0 (feeders' constructors kept spending), the frame took 2:21, and the plant died at 9:17 before its first moho (10:22). The trigger 'first bank' fired at 3:40 with 16 of 24 spots taken.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file, ledger row, results.jsonl or review.md. His economy, army and tier-2 clock are floors from sightings, and which person played Cortex is our models' inference (the script says Armada for both). minutes.py, analyze_match.py, floor.py, raid_ledger.py and wake_read.py read only record-0/strategist-0, so I ran them on per-seat symlink views in the scratchpad. Per-seat armies include transferred units, so the per-seat windows mislead, and I summed the seats by hand. pro_baseline.py does not apply (not Comet Catcher). impedance_sweep counts the commander's three refused transfers as 0 refused (the refusal prints only the usage line). analyze s2's last engagement (13:15-16:42, 10,721 lost) runs past the surrender at about 16:28, and 4,140 of t4's losses fall after it. No person commented, so every 'because' here is a model's (ours, or our players' and commander's notes). Reader's slip: from 00:55:14 to about 00:55:50 (2026-10-22) I overwrote the shared scratchpad views seat0/seat1/seat2/cmdr, which belong to the SD-129 reader (1792547311-human). I pointed them back at that game's files. A tool run by that reader inside those 36 s would have read this game's records.

open_questions: Was the side ever ahead in army on the spot? Our side summed 2,839 at 8:00 and 3,369 at 9:00 against 964 and 1,126 seen, but by unique id he fielded 54 Pawns, 49 Grunts and 45 Maces over the game. Without a truth file the lead is unknown.

Would a held line first (Sentries at every spot, labs on soldiers) and a sprint at the side's 24 spots have survived two people on this map, or does a 24-spot half against two people call for no early sprint at all? The procedure's 'first bank' trigger fired at 3:40.
Which person was Cortex? The start script says Armada for both; our models assumed thebluegecko.
The direction of 7:58 reached t3's order at 8:22: how much of the one-at-a-time defence is the commander's latency (21 s turn wall), not the players' choices?
